$comment: The one pinned definition of every external tool HeroesReplay runs. `heroesreplay deps install` downloads each archive, checks size and SHA-256, and extracts only `files` into Dependencies:Directory\<name>. `heroesreplay check ffmpeg` compares the -version line with `version`. To move to a new build: download the asset once, compute its SHA-256 (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256), and change version, url, size, and sha256 together.
